clm-invest-rule-forward-pe.notes: Author's own strategy statement; single primary source set (shared independence key), no independent corroboration of effectiveness.
clm-invest-rule-forward-pe.text: The strategy buys only when Forward P/E <= TTM P/E, treating Forward > TTM as valuation-shock risk.

clm-invest-rule-institutions.notes: Author's own strategy statement; single primary source set (shared independence key), no independent corroboration of effectiveness.
clm-invest-rule-institutions.text: The strategy defines institutional involvement as volume ratio above 1.5 with turnover above 1 percent near support, VWAP, or a key MA.

clm-invest-rule-ma200-trend.notes: Author's own strategy statement; single primary source set (shared independence key), no independent corroboration of effectiveness.
clm-invest-rule-ma200-trend.text: The strategy requires price above MA200, enters on MA10 or MA50 pullbacks, and exits short-term trades on a daily close below MA30.

clm-invest-rule-vwap.notes: Author's own strategy statement; single primary source set (shared independence key), no independent corroboration of effectiveness.
clm-invest-rule-vwap.text: The strategy treats VWAP as the day's fair-value line and buys only above or on reclaim of VWAP.

clm-soulz-hl-hvn.notes: Best of the four tested translations: 70-89 day holds, positive on 4 of 7 instruments, but only 1-11 trades each; retained as an optional filter, not a rule.
clm-soulz-hl-hvn.text: A higher low forming at a High Volume Node signals strong support (guide p.29).

clm-soulz-hvn-continuation.notes: Own daily-bar backtests (2016-2026, 7 instruments) found the translation positive but strictly worse than a plain EMA12/21 trend rule everywhere; daily proxies may understate the intraday claim.
clm-soulz-hvn-continuation.text: A breakout above a High Volume Node with dominant buying pressure signals continuation (guide p.28).

clm-soulz-liquidation-magnets.notes: No historical liquidation or order-book depth data available; untestable here.
clm-soulz-liquidation-magnets.text: Liquidation clusters act as price magnets that fuel squeezes and cascades (guide pp.18-20).

clm-soulz-no-independent-evidence.notes: Web round 2026-08-25 found only vendor/education material for volume-profile/POC methods; no peer-reviewed study located. Recorded as an absence-of-evidence observation, not proof of absence.
clm-soulz-no-independent-evidence.text: No independent peer-reviewed evidence was found that volume-profile/POC trading methods are profitable.

clm-tasty-payoff-formulas.notes: Independently verified 2026-08-25 against a live NVDA chain with the Vibe-Trading payoff analyzer (Black-Scholes, no dividends/assignment); exact agreement.
clm-tasty-payoff-formulas.text: The guide's max-profit/max-loss/breakeven formulas for short puts and iron condors are arithmetically correct.

clm-tasty-performance.notes: Upgraded 2026-08-25: Bondarenko/Cboe 2019 shows 32-year index put-writing matched S&P return at ~2/3 volatility (single commissioned source; mechanics differ from the 45-DTE/50%-management recipe). One low-authority live trial of modified mechanics went negative despite a 70% win rate. Not accepted: no independent test of the exact doctrine.
clm-tasty-performance.text: Following the premium-selling doctrine produces superior long-run risk-adjusted returns.

clm-tasty-premium-doctrine.notes: Accepted as a description of what the guide teaches (the source is authoritative about its own doctrine). Effectiveness is a separate, untested question.
clm-tasty-premium-doctrine.text: The tastylive approach sells option premium around 45 DTE in high IV, manages winners at 50% of max profit, and defends by rolling for credits.
